name: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd
title: Brigade Hotel Ventures Ltd - 544457 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hotel operator with no capacity-cycle signal: Q4 RevPAR +6% on ADR +7% and flat 78% occupancy, but revenue only +8% and F&B hit by war cancellations of INR7-8 crore; FY27 capex ~INR3,600 crore is a growth plan, not discipline.

capex.quote: Our planned capex of approximately INR3,600 crores, of which INR400 crores has already been invested by FY '26

triggers.label: ADR ₹8,066 record, +7% YoY
triggers.quote: our ADR if you look at it is ₹8,066 for the portfolio, which is the highest ADR on average that we have received

triggers.label: Cancellations ₹7-8 crore Apr-Jun
triggers.quote: we also got some cancellations worth about INR7 crores to INR8 crores, but we are trying to make that up with more domestic business
triggers.highlight: cancellations worth about INR7 crores to INR8 crores

triggers.label: ARR >₹10,000 by FY29, >₹14,000 by FY31
triggers.quote: we project this to exceed INR10,000 for an average ADR by FY '29 and surpass INR14,000 by FY31

triggers.label: Capex ~₹3,600 crore, 60% debt-funded
triggers.quote: Our planned capex of approximately INR3,600 crores, of which INR400 crores has already been invested

guidance.quote: we project this to exceed INR10,000 for an average ADR by FY '29 and surpass INR14,000 by FY31
we do believe that there is gap to move this average portfolio occupancy from 78% to somewhere in the mid to low 80s

red_flags.label: Margin hit by GST 2.0 input credit reversal
red_flags.quote: GST 2.0 has resulted in a 1.4% impact on EBITDA margin for Q4 FY '26

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT lifted by other income and FD interest
red_flags.quote: The other income has increased due to interest on fixed deposit what we have kept with the bank

red_flags.label: MICE cancellations linked to war
red_flags.quote: we faced a few cancellations on account of larger events which are dependent on the foreign travellers

evasions.quote: very hard to predict what will come back and what will get cancelled
